statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is in the low band because the U.S. cash session finished modestly above the prior NDX close after a substantial rebound from the intraday low, with no verified persistent failed-retracement sequence.
recommendation: Published policy mapping: EA_ON. The next concentrated risk window is Wednesday's U.S. cash open and Employer Costs release; any escalation remains conditional on persistent live repricing with failed repair.
headline: Cash-session repair keeps Tail low despite extreme macro Stress
body: Official Nasdaq NDX data showed 29,588.33 versus a 29,544.16 prior close after trading down to 29,400.70. Oil at a six-week high, a U.S. 10-year yield near 4.8% and Middle East escalation keep Stress extreme, but technology leadership is split and the observed index path repaired materially.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hours, published Tail ranged from 17% to 32%. The peak came during the 14:00 UTC cash-open downside extension, then fell below WATCH as the session repaired. Stress stayed extreme, while modes shifted among event/whipsaw, trend and mixed.
outlookSummary: The base case keeps Tail low overnight and through Europe. WATCH conditions increase into Wednesday's U.S. pre-open, cash open and 14:00 UTC Employer Costs release, with a separate WATCH checkpoint around the 17:00 UTC Apple event. Future escalation requires observed persistent repricing and failed repair.

forecast.analysis: Official Nasdaq NDX data at the cutoff showed 29,588.33, up 0.15% from the prior close after rebounding from a 29,400.70 session low. That repaired, two-sided path keeps Tail low while oil near six-week highs and elevated yields sustain extreme Stress.
drivers: NDX rebounded deeply from the session low and finished modestly above the prior close
Brent settled near a six-week high

forecast.analysis: Early post-close Tail stays low if futures continue rotating around the repaired cash-session area. Thin liquidity can raise noise, but escalation would require sustained extension with shallow or failed counter-moves.
Late U.S. evening remains low Tail under balanced futures rotation. A directional break matters only if it holds near an extreme and survives meaningful retracement attempts.

At the Asia handoff, low Tail assumes the repaired U.S. session carries into orderly price discovery. New geopolitical headlines could lift Stress rapidly, but Tail requires persistent NQ follow-through.
Early Asia remains mixed if futures trade two-sided despite elevated oil and rates. Cross-asset pressure would become a Tail amplifier only alongside efficient NQ direction and failed repair.
Asia-session Tail stays low if pullbacks and reversals remain meaningful. A one-way extension synchronized with yields, volatility and technology breadth would challenge this baseline.
drivers: Cross-asset alignment if a directional move emerges

forecast.analysis: Mid-Asia keeps a low-Tail base case. The key checkpoint is whether any overnight directional move repeatedly extends after shallow retracements rather than rotating back through prior levels.
Later Asia remains low Tail unless a directional move becomes increasingly efficient and holds near an overnight extreme. Headline volatility alone is treated primarily as Stress.
The pre-Europe handoff is modeled as mixed. Stable two-sided futures trade keeps Tail contained; a clean break that survives the handoff without repair would raise the next-hour risk.
drivers: Repair of any overnight directional break

forecast.analysis: Ahead of European liquidity, Tail remains low if overnight structure is balanced. Alignment between NQ direction, oil, yields and technology proxies would be needed for a stronger escalation.
drivers: Potential alignment of NQ, oil, yields and technology

forecast.analysis: Europe's opening hour carries slightly more path risk because liquidity broadens. Tail remains low unless an overnight move is reinforced rather than retraced as Europe joins price discovery.
European follow-through remains low Tail if the opening impulse is repaired. Repeated extension toward an overnight extreme with shallow counter-moves would increase concern.
Mid-European trade is modeled as mixed. Persistent oil and yield pressure keeps Stress elevated, while Tail depends on whether NQ itself stops mean-reverting.
Late European morning remains low Tail if futures continue rotating. A sustained directional bias into the U.S. premarket would raise the importance of the next transition.
As U.S. participation builds, Tail approaches the top of the low band. The key condition is whether premarket direction persists through meaningful retracement attempts.
Premarket risk remains near WATCH without assuming a one-way move. Stronger alignment across NQ, semiconductors, megacaps, yields and volatility would raise the opening-path risk.
The pre-open hour enters WATCH because U.S. liquidity and the upcoming Employer Costs release concentrate repricing risk. The score remains conditional on live structure rather than the event itself.
The cash-open hour is WATCH. Tail rises only if the opening auction establishes an extreme, pullbacks stay shallow and extension repeats ahead of the 14:00 UTC Employer Costs release.

Employer Costs are a WATCH checkpoint, not an automatic block. Tail would rise further only if the release produces persistent NQ repricing with failed repair; orderly two-sided discovery would lower it.
The first post-release hour remains WATCH while the market tests whether any data impulse persists. Meaningful retracement and cross-asset stabilization would move the path back toward low Tail.
Late morning holds a WATCH baseline as attention shifts from macro repricing toward the Apple event. Tail stays contained unless a directional U.S. session keeps extending without repair.
The Apple event hour is a company-catalyst WATCH window. Escalation requires broad index-level continuation and failed retracements; event importance alone does not establish pathological Tail.
drivers: Index-level breadth of any technology reaction

forecast.analysis: Post-event Tail remains WATCH only if any technology impulse broadens and persists. Divergent megacap or semiconductor reactions and two-sided NQ trade would favor rapid normalization.
Power-hour risk returns to the low band if the day has shown meaningful repair. A fresh extreme held through repeated failed pullbacks would be the condition for renewed escalation.
